ai.assistant_welcome_title:
Take your time —
I'll help you shape ideas and plot.
ai.assistant_quick_outline_subtitle: Turn vague ideas into scenes you can actually write.
ai.assistant_quick_polish_subtitle: Soften the imagery, refine the rhythm.
ai.agent_quick_plot_structure_sub: Outline acts, turning points, and key events.
ai.agent_quick_generate_cover_sub: Create a visual concept for the book cover.
ai.agent_quick_planner_outline_sub: Create beats a writer can execute directly.
ai.agent_quick_planner_outline_prompt: Read the current novel context, previous chapter text, relevant characters, and active foreshadowing first. Then create a chapter outline for the next chapter that a writer can use directly. List scene goals, character actions, conflict progression, information changes, foreshadowing to advance or pay off, and the chapter-end hook by beat.
ai.agent_quick_planner_continuity_sub: Verify timeline, character states, and foreshadowing.
ai.agent_quick_planner_continuity_prompt: Read the recent chapters, current outline, character states, and active foreshadowing. Check the facts that must carry into the next chapter before planning. Output timeline, character locations and states, information boundaries, foreshadowing to advance, and uncertain items. Do not turn unconfirmed information into established fact.
ai.agent_quick_writer_draft_sub: Write usable prose from the outline beats.
ai.agent_quick_writer_draft_prompt: Read this chapter's outline, the previous chapter text, relevant character cards, and active foreshadowing first. Then expand this chapter strictly following the outline beats. Output only prose, with no title, explanation, analysis, or Markdown.
ai.agent_quick_writer_continue_prompt: Read the previous chapter or the current chapter draft, then continue the current scene while preserving timeline, point of view, character states, and emotional aftermath. Match the established narrative style and output only prose, with no creative notes.
ai.agent_quick_artist_cover_sub: Use genre, hook, and mood for the cover concept.
ai.agent_quick_artist_cover_prompt: Read the novel title, synopsis, genre, core characters, and current mood. First provide a brief cover concept including subject, composition, palette, title integration, and font style. Then use the cover generation tool to generate a vertical novel cover.
ai.agent_quick_artist_character_sub: Extract appearance, outfit, palette, and symbols.
ai.agent_quick_artist_character_prompt: Read the relevant character profile and novel context, then design a generatable visual concept for the current character. Describe silhouette, outfit style, color palette, signature elements, and expression. If the target is clear, use the avatar or photo generation tool.
ai.agent_quick_chronicler_facts_sub: Save character, location, relation, and foreshadowing changes.
ai.agent_quick_chronicler_facts_prompt: Read the current chapter text and outline, plus existing character, location, faction, skill, item, and relationship data. Extract explicit fact changes from this chapter and save them with the available tools. Prioritize hard facts the next chapter must know.
ai.agent_quick_chronicler_continuity_sub: Check time, space, items, and information boundaries.
ai.agent_quick_chronicler_continuity_pro: Read the recent chapters, character states, relationship graph, and foreshadowing records. Check continuity across timeline, movement, item ownership, information boundaries, relationship changes, and world rules. If you find conflicts, write them as items to verify; do not invent fixes.
ai.agent_quick_custom_context_sub: Let the agent align with material before acting.
ai.agent_quick_custom_context_prompt: Read the context, source material, and user rules relevant to your current task first. Summarize the facts, constraints, and uncertain items you must follow, then perform the task according to your role setup.
ai.agent_quick_custom_start_sub: Run the task according to this agent prompt.
ai.agent_quick_custom_start_prompt: Follow your role setup and the current context to perform the task. Align with available material and the user's current goal first, then output a directly usable result. If information is missing, state the gap or read the context first.
ai.agent_quick_orchestrator_plan_today_s: Create a focused plan for the next three chapters.
ai.agent_quick_orchestrator_plan_today_p: Read the current novel context, current chapter state, recent chapters, outline, character states, foreshadowing records, and user rules first. Then plan today's writing work around the next 3 chapters. For each chapter, list the goal, key scenes, conflict movement, required continuity checks, writing tasks, and a realistic execution order for today.

ai.chat_onboarding_message: Tell me what you want to do — write a chapter, develop a character, build a world, or anything else. I'll help you make it happen.
ai.chat_onboarding_agent_message: Choose the agent that fits what you need — different agents specialize in writing, planning, illustration, and more.
ai.chat_onboarding_model_message: Choose the model that fits your goal — models differ in speed, quality, and cost.
ai.chat_onboarding_cover_message: In the novel overview on the left, click the cover image to open Cover Studio. You can use AI to generate beautiful covers, or upload your own images.
ai.feature_onboarding.council_intro: The AI Council brings multiple AI agents together to discuss your story from different perspectives — plot, character, pacing, and more.
ai.feature_onboarding.council_how_to: Tap + to start a new council session. Assign roles to each agent, then sit back and watch them debate your story.
ai.feature_onboarding.monologue_intro: Monologue lets an AI step into a character's mind and speak their inner thoughts aloud — perfect for exploring motivation, emotion, and voice.
ai.feature_onboarding.monologue_how_to: Select a character, then ask the AI to generate a monologue in their voice. Use this to deepen character development.
ai.feature_onboarding.theater_intro: Theater brings multiple AI-controlled characters into a scene to act out dialogue and interactions — like a table read for your novel.
ai.feature_onboarding.theater_how_to: Set up characters and context, then let the AI run the scene. Watch your characters come alive through natural conversation.
ai.feature_onboarding.roleplay_intro: Roleplay lets you step into a character's shoes and interact with the AI in real-time — explore scenarios, test dialogue, or improvise story directions.
ai.feature_onboarding.roleplay_how_to: Choose a character and setting, then start a conversation. The AI responds as the world and characters around you.
ai.feature_onboarding.agent_rules_intro: Rules define writing preferences and constraints for AI responses, like saying "always write in third-person past tense" or "never introduce new characters without asking."
ai.feature_onboarding.agent_rules_how_to: Create a rule with a name and instruction. Rules are evaluated before every AI response, so your preferences are always respected.
ai.feature_onboarding.cover_studio_intro: Cover Studio turns the novel's premise, genre, and visual direction into a ready-to-send image prompt.
ai.feature_onboarding.cover_studio_how_t: Choose a style, describe the mood, then send it to the artist agent. The generated image can be applied as the novel cover from the chat result.
ai.feature_onboarding.avatar_generation_: Character image generation helps you keep a visual reference for important roles instead of relying only on text notes.
Pick an art style from the character profile. Avatar prompts open in the AI panel with the current character attached as context.
ai.feature_onboarding.outline_craft_intr: Outlines are the place to shape the story spine before writing scenes, from premise and stakes to timeline beats.
ai.feature_onboarding.outline_craft_how_: Start with the premise, goal, conflict, and ending payoff. Add timeline beats in cause-and-effect order so later chapters have a clear route.
ai.feature_onboarding.feature_usage_intr: Novel Editor combines writing, worldbuilding, and AI chat in one workspace. Use the left rail to move between sections, and the right AI panel when you want help shaping content.
ai.feature_onboarding.feature_usage_how_: Use the rail for chapters, characters, maps, and notes, and open AI modes from the agent section when you want council, monologue, theater, or roleplay support.
ai.rollback_message_confirm_message: This will undo AI changes from this turn, remove later conversation messages, and put the original prompt back in the composer.
